stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Can we tidy before Hesper edits?

stations.title: Top folder
stations.text: A loose invoice, a muddled poster name.
stations.note: No copy of prices or orders.

stations.title: Your commands
stations.gap: Files sit in the wrong place

captions: At Ashgrove, Idris wants things filed and backed up before Hesper changes prices.
Today an invoice lies loose, the fox poster has a muddled name, and nothing is backed up.
You copy and move files into place, in four tasks.
The invoice is filed with March, the poster is renamed, and both backups exist.
Copies keep the old, moves tidy the new. The folder is safer and neater.
